ruleBookInfo.name: @js:(function(){var t=String(result||"");var m=t.match(/"@type":\s*"(?:ComicStory|Book|VideoObject)"[\s\S]{0,3000}?"name":\s*"([^"]+)"/);if(m)return m[1];try{var h=t.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]{0,150}?)<\/h1>/);if(h)return h[1].replace(/<[^>]*>/g,"").trim();}catch(e2){}return "";})()
ruleBookInfo.author: @js:(function(){try{var m=String(result).match(/"author":\s*\{\s*"@type":\s*"Person",\s*"name":\s*"([^"]+)"/);if(m)return m[1];}catch(e){}try{var a=String(result).match(/all\/author\/[^>]*>([^<]+)</);if(a)return a[1];}catch(e2){}return "";})()
ruleBookInfo.coverUrl: @js:(function(){var t=String(result||"");var H=String(baseUrl).match(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/);H=H?H[0]:"https://abandon.yyc2mhau.cc";var m=t.match(/data-src="https?:\/\/[^\/?]+(\/upload[^"]+)"/);if(m){var p=m[1].split("?")[0];var b=java.base64Encode(p);var ext=p.split(".").pop();return H+"/social-cover/"+b+"."+ext;}try{var og=t.match(/og:image" content="([^"]+)"/);if(og)return og[1];}catch(e2){}return "";})()
